verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Computer Use, which lets ChatGPT see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS or Windows. Supporting docs cover a desktop-app testing use case, using your computer from the desktop workspace, and screenshots being governed by data controls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Computer Use, and documentation of per-app permission and approval controls and of reliability on real-world multi-app work.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work

citations.quote: With Computer Use, ChatGPT can see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS or Windows.
Testing a macOS app, Windows app, iOS simulator flow, or another desktop app that ChatGPT is building.
Run projects in parallel, work with files, use your computer, and keep long-running work moving from one desktop workspace.
Your ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use.
